For those not in the LLZK channel, this might be of interest:
@Elizaveta Pertseva has kindly agreed to give a talk about the work she blogged about here. The candidate date for this is Monday the 13th of October at some time between 8 and 11am PDT, so I am running a poll here to determine the best time.

Talk: Automated Lean Proofs for Every Type
Monday, October 13 · Mon, 13 Oct 2025, 5:00 pm
Google Meet joining info
Video call link: https://meet.google.com/cqg-ypwq-fgd

I've set an invite to those that replied to the poll, but the calendar event is also public on this calendar.
